mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book ( isbn, book_title, book_author, publisher, book_thumbnail, book_contents, published_date ) VALUES ( #{isbn}, #{bookTitle}, #{bookAuthor}, #{publisher}, #{bookThumbnail}, #{bookContents}, #{publishedDate} )
mapper.select: SELECT book_idx AS bookIdx, isbn, book_title AS bookTitle, book_author AS bookAuthor, publisher, book_thumbnail AS bookThumbnail, book_contents AS bookContents, published_date AS publishedDate, created_at AS createdAt FROM book WHERE isbn = #{isbn}
